edits.text:
Summary of the video.

- The host bakes a sourdough loaf with a 72-hour cold ferment.
- He compares rye and whole-wheat starters and prefers rye for flavour.
- The crumb came out open; the crust burned slightly at 260 C.
- Overall he recommends a lower oven temperature and a longer bake.
